page.overview:
Who is Adeleas Namelle?

Adeleas Namelle was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She was Vandene's older sister., Adeleas Namelle|Adeleas}}

Adeleas was slender and white-haired. She wore her hair at the back of her neck.

Many people had difficulty telling Adeleas and Vandene apart, even though they were from different Ajahs. They did not understand how people could make this mistake. Mat thought they were so alike that they may as well have been twins.

Adeleas is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Adeleas was not strong enough to Travel.
